messages:
sam-sales: FYI vendor AcmeCloud submitted invoice but says their W-9 EIN doesn't match Stripe records. asking for payment hold lift so they can pay subcontractor gross-up.
anna-finance: holding payment until we confirm EIN. vendor provided w-9 PDF but EIN on top header = 12-3456789 while vendor portal shows 98-7654321.
mike-accounting: did we ever update their tax profile after the legal name change last year? :thinking_face:
rachel-legal: we have two entities on file (AcmeCloud Inc. and AcmeCloud US LLC). EIN mismatch could be the LLC vs parent. need the vendor to confirm which entity the invoice is billing.
sam-sales: vendor says invoice is for the US LLC but their Stripe account is under the parent. they attached invoice:
```
Invoice: 2026-04-11 #INV-99871
Bill To: Redwood Inference (PO 9987)
Vendor: AcmeCloud US LLC
EIN: 12-3456789
Amount: $18,400.00
Tax withholding: none (they request gross-up for subcontractor fees)
```
anna-finance: ok can we get a signed w-9 for AcmeCloud US LLC matching EIN 12-3456789? current file in vendor portal is for parent and has 98-7654321.
payments-bot: e-sign request sent to vendor contact <vendor-payments@acmecloud.com> for W-9 (AcmeCloud US LLC). Status: failed delivery.
mike-accounting: any chance vendor uses a different email for e-sign? their AP contact on the invoice is ap_us@acmecloud.com (different). I'll re-send.
sam-sales: pinging my contact Laura at AcmeCloud to confirm which EIN to use.
laura (via sam-sales): "sorry — we had a parent-level transition. invoice should be billed from AcmeCloud US LLC; I'll upload corrected W-9 and re-authorize e-sign from ap_us@acmecloud.com"
rachel-legal: once we have matching W-9 we can clear payment. if they need a gross-up, we need a formal signed addendum that confirms Redwood will reimburse gross-up amounts and the rate. why is this needed here?
anna-finance: vendor says subcontractor requires gross-up because of local withholding. it's on them to provide calculation and signed attestation. we will not change tax classification without docs.
mike-accounting: re-sent e-sign to ap_us@acmecloud.com. Payments bot shows queued.
payments-bot: e-sign attempt delivered. Vendor started signing (1/3).
sam-sales: thanks — vendor expects 48h turnaround. if they can get W-9 + gross-up attestation signed, can we fast-track?
anna-finance: we can do expedited ACH after docs verified, but need PO match and manager approval. tagging @mike-accounting for final OK.
mike-accounting: putting this through expedited queue pending signed W-9 and attestation. please upload signed docs to vendor portal and reply here. :white_check_mark:
rachel-legal: also request a declaration that AcmeCloud US LLC is the billing entity for this PO to avoid future mismatches.
sam-sales: noted. I'll confirm with Laura and ask them to re-issue invoice referencing the LLC and PO.
anna-finance: final note — if vendor insists on gross-up, finance will require line showing gross-up calculation and tax authority citation. no vague statements.
sam-sales: copy that. I'll update vendor and close loop. :thumbsup:
